title: 140 Pieces is Not Enough
text: 140 Pieces is Not Enough. These are very nice artificial pearls without holes drilled in them, but I was disappointed that 140 barely fill your palm. I wanted to use these in vases/candle holders for wedding decor, but they would be too expensive to use them for that purpose. I used clear vase filler instead. They are better suited for small craft projects.
